Good to know

How much is delivery?

Delivery is quoted separately. Share your town, area and landmark or GhanaPost GPS address on WhatsApp. ORVELLA will confirm coverage, the charge and expected timing before payment.

Can I get the pair price if I add bottles separately?

Yes. Each complete matching pair receives its named pair price automatically. Extra bottles keep their individual price. The bag and WhatsApp summary show the exact saving.

How do I know which scent to choose?

Use the scent filters, compare bottles or try the fragrance finder. Product details show the opening, heart and base notes from the brand. You can also ask ORVELLA for personal help.

What should I confirm before payment?

Confirm the bottle, packaging, availability, delivery charge and timing, official payment details, and the exchange or return conditions. Your WhatsApp message is an order request until ORVELLA confirms it.
